channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: A 150-year-old bottle of mystery alcohol was uncovered at Alta. What was it, and how did it taste?
item.description: The bottle had held up “surprisingly” well, even though it saw “150 summers, 150 winters underneath the ground at Alta Ski Resort," said an analyst who helped test and try its contents.

item.title: What family members want you to know about the 3 men who died after being left in a running van
item.description: Their families remember an "infectious smile," a "gentle spirit," and a "huge impact" on community.

item.title: Legisladores de Utah impulsan paquete de medidas contra inmigrantes en medio del debate nacional
item.description: Mientras el debate nacional sobre inmigración se intensifica, legisladores de Utah proponen medidas que afectarían beneficios públicos, licencias de conducir y programas estatales para inmigrantes.

item.title: The national immigration debate comes to Utah: Here’s what state lawmakers are proposing
item.description: As anti-ICE protests erupt around the country, and as Congress debates Homeland Security funding, the Legislature is considering bills that would impact immigrants already living in Utah.

item.title: 13 Utah lawmakers won’t seek reelection in 2026 — but nearly every open seat is contested
item.description: Several of Utah's prominent lawmakers, including Senate President J. Stuart Adams, will see primary challenges this year. And 13 others will leave the Legislature altogether.

item.title: After a Utah inmate spent 36 years on death row and died of natural causes, a lawmaker wants to speed up the process
item.description: Ralph Menzies spent 36 years on Utah’s death row. He died last year after his execution was stopped over competency concerns. Now a lawmaker says the system is broken — and she wants to speed it up.

item.title: Despite Trump funding cut, a key St. George highway project may not be dead
item.description: Construction on I-15 underpasses in St George set to begin next fall if state and city officials can offset the funding cut by the Trump administration.

item.title: Prop 4 repeal signatures now past 117K as counting continues
item.description: Here is where the Republican-backed signature-gathering effort to repeal Utah's ban on gerrymandering stands as of the latest update.

item.title: Utah Supreme Court rejects Legislature’s last-ditch bid to undo state’s new congressional maps
item.description: The Utah Supreme Court rejected the Legislature’s last-ditch bid to undo the state's new congressional maps. The justices said that the Legislature failed to file an appropriate appeal in a timely manner.

item.title: John Curtis says Supreme Court striking Trump’s tariffs affirms a ‘system of checks and balances’
item.description: Utah's U.S. Sen. John Curtis applauded the U.S. Supreme Court's ruling striking down President Donald Trump’s tariffs. Here's what he said.
